pages.name: Sky Underwater
pages.description: The reflected tower sways on the water. A copper weather vane turns on its roof.

options.description: Throw a pebble into the water

pages.name: Cold Depths
pages.description: For a moment, your hand passes through the surface and returns holding a little copper weather vane.

scenePatch.description: A tower without a weather vane on its roof is reflected in the water.

pages.name: Ripples on the Water
pages.description: The reflection dissolves into ripples. When the water settles, only ordinary clouds are visible.

scenePatch.description: The pond reflects only the real sky.

pages.name: Distant Tower
pages.description: You leave, while the impossible tower continues swaying in the depths.
